annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/2226 of 14 December 2021 laying down rules for the application of Regulation (EU) 2017/745 as regards electronic instructions for use of medical devices
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/2226 of 14 December 2021 laying down rules for the application of Regulation (EU) 2017/745 as regards electronic instructions for use of medical devices
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (L 448/32)
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission implementing regulation setting conditions under which medical device manufacturers may supply instructions for use electronically instead of on paper under the Medical Devices Regulation 2017/745. It requires documented risk assessments, paper copies on request, website safeguards and GDPR compliance, and repeals Regulation 207/2012.
key_provisions_or_claims: Electronic IFU permitted only for implantable, fixed installed or built-in-display devices used exclusively by professionals, and for software.
Manufacturers must perform and update a documented risk assessment showing safety is maintained.
Paper IFU must be supplied free within 7 days of request.
Websites must be secure, stable, GDPR-compliant and keep historical versions for 10-15 years.
Notified bodies review compliance during conformity assessment; Regulation 207/2012 repealed.
